title: Adding customers sums up the change and names the count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. Tick customer B.
  7. Tick customer C.
  8. Untick Part Sales on customer C's row.
  9. Click Add 3 Customers.
  10. Click the Customers tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows Manage Customers.

Step 4:

  • The footer reads "No customers picked yet."
  • The add button is off.

Step 5:

  • Customer A is ticked.

Step 6:

  • Customer B is ticked.

Step 7:

  • Customer C is ticked with both channels.

Step 8:

  • The footer reads "Adding 3 customers: 2 for both, 1 for Work Orders only." (2 + 1 = 3).
  • The button reads "Add 3 Customers".

Step 9:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 10:

  • Tier A's Customers tab lists customers A and B for both channels and customer C for work orders.
